# Image-to-Video

Animate any still image on RunComfy, as a smart router that picks the right image-to-video model for the intent. HappyHorse 1.0 I2V is the default for portrait and product animation with identity preservation and native in-pass audio (image JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least 300 px, up to 10 MB, clips 3 to 15 s). Wan 2.7 with audio_url is used when you have a custom voiceover track to lip-sync (WAV or MP3, 3 to 30 s, up to 15 MB). Seedance 2.0 Pro handles multi-modal animation combining a subject image with reference video and reference audio (up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio tracks). Every run goes through the RunComfy CLI and is charged by RunComfy.
